Write the general term in the binomial expansion of $\left(x - \frac{2}{x}\right)^5$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{5}{r} x^{5 - r} \left(-\frac{2}{x}\right)^r = \binom{5}{r} (-2)^r x^{5 - 2r}$$

Set the power of $x$ to $-1$ to find the index $r$ for the term in $\frac{1}{x}$:
$$5 - 2r = -1 \implies 2r = 6 \implies r = 3$$

Substitute $r = 3$ to calculate the coefficient:
$$\text{Term} = \binom{5}{3} (-2)^3 x^{-1} = 10 \times (-8) x^{-1} = -80x^{-1}$$
$$\text{Coefficient of } \frac{1}{x} = -80$$
